author: pm
body:
Linux build and behaviour; exclusive folded into borderless (user, 2026-11-25).

Plan: .claude/design/plans/system-menu-display-overhaul.md (part of HH-0114).

**Done when:** built, reviewed and checked in game.

Linux verification (editor, 2026-11-26, WSL Ubuntu, Debug):
- Client build: rc 0, 0 warnings (149 objects recompiled incl. display_settings.h, sfml_window/renderer, config_manager, sys menu, game, game_mode_manager, ccontrols). Server build: rc 0, 0 warnings (only 1 object rebuilt; server does not include the overhaul files). measured.
- Read paths (verified by reading): is_window_mode_supported false for exclusive; saved exclusive folds to borderless in apply_display_settings and Alt-Enter; resolution list capped by sf::VideoMode::getDesktopMode; refresh list curated only (get_display_refresh_rates empty off Windows); set_display_refresh_rate stubbed false; menu lists only supported modes.
- Note (not a fault, pre-existing): get_monitor_refresh_rate returns 60 on Linux, so vsync frame cap is 60 there.
- GUI run under WSLg with a saved "exclusive": window opened, borderless at 1408x881, main menu drew, Alt-Enter -> windowed 800x600 (saved windowed), Alt-Enter -> borderless (saved borderless). Screenshots in .claude/scratch/editor/hh0121/. measured.
- No fixes needed; no files edited.

**Verified, 2026-11-26:** Linux client and server Debug builds, 0 warnings (149 client objects recompiled incl. every overhaul file); Linux paths verified by reading (exclusive unsupported and folded to borderless, desktop-capped resolutions, curated refresh list, Windows rate call stubbed); WSLg run: saved exclusive opened borderless, Alt-Enter windowed <-> borderless and saved. No fix needed. Verifies the overhaul as of e174ed23.
